slides.title: A million refugees, and registration has stopped
slides.body: UNHCR warns funding cuts are hitting refugees in Ethiopia

slides.title: Ethiopia hosts 1,023,565 refugees and asylum-seekers
slides.body: as of Aug. 31, 2026, Government/UNHCR data show. Most live in Gambela (441,416) and the Somali region (361,366).

slides.title: from South Sudan
slides.body: the largest group, followed by 362,151 from Somalia, 124,650 from Eritrea and 57,694 from Sudan (UNHCR data).

slides.title: Registration halted
slides.body: for tens of thousands of people arriving from South Sudan and Eritrea, UN News reported on Oct. 12. Hundreds of thousands more await verification.

slides.title: received of $8.5B needed
slides.body: UNHCR's funding so far in 2026, worldwide. Its chief, Barham Salih, warned: "Efficiency has limits."

slides.title: Protect refugees. Keep humanitarian aid flowing.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: UN News, Oct 12, 2026 · UNHCR data, Aug 31, 2026
